scope: Diagnostic drift localisation and minimal correction only. No formal batch, no held-out, no formal success.

fixed.release_action: last public OPEN, target = measured EE + [0,0,0.15] m
fixed.sample_clock: after release_retreat returns: steps 0..330 at 60 Hz; formal window 210..330

variants.name: baseline reproduction with diagnostic recording
variants.change: none to policy, path, material, ground or release hold; add per-step diagnostic recording only
variants.question: Is the original drift reproducible with the diagnostic recorder?

variants.name: delayed retreat
variants.change: release/ungrasp and open; arm temporarily holds position; then retreat
variants.status: registered_not_run; delay length to be fixed after step 3
variants.question: Does the cloth drift before the retreat begins?
variants.budget: Must stay within 12 public actions; no hidden waypoints.

variants.name: detachment path comparison
variants.question: Does a different robot detachment path reduce the drift?

recording_requirements: per-physical-step cloth vertices from release action start through retreat end
gripper pose, opening amount, holding and all three attachment enables
available contact object, time, force and impulse; if only distance is available, label it as distance evidence and do not call it contact
same physical time span for every compared segment
report both the original 210..330 evaluation and the diagnostic phases
stop_conditions: D0 does not reproduce the original drift: stop and investigate version/repeatability
code/config/physics/action targets change without a new registration
contact records remain unavailable and the next step cannot distinguish hypotheses
a variant requires more than 12 public actions without a registered budget change
